name: Asteria
blurb: Asteria is a comprehensive astrological chart application that combines traditional astrology with modern AI technology.
description:
Asteria is a comprehensive astrological chart application that combines traditional astrology with modern AI technology.

Features:

• Calculate and display natal charts with precise planetary positions

• Analyze aspects between planets with detailed interpretations

• View planetary positions by house and sign

• Examine element and modality distributions

• Generate AI-powered chart interpretations for deeper insights

• Calculate transit charts to see how current planetary positions affect your natal chart

• Clean, intuitive interface for both beginners and experienced astrologers

• Composite, Davison, and Synastry relationship charts

• Return charts for Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto

• Secondary progression charts

• Solar and lunar eclipse calculations

• Zodiac Signs chart with magazine-style horoscopes

• Customizable aspect orb slider and additional celestial bodies (Lilith, Ceres, Pallas, Juno, Vesta, Vertex, East Point, Part of Spirit)

• Aspect Display Settings for customizing aspect line thickness and style

• Display Settings for chart size, wheel thickness, planet size, glyph size, and UI font size

• Multi-provider AI support including Mistral, OpenAI, Groq, Ollama, and Gemini

• Transit, Aspect, and Synastry filters for detailed data exploration

• Julian/Gregorian calendar toggle for dates before 1582

• Export charts as PNG, SVG, PDF, or text

• Share charts with watermark via social dialog

• Multi-window support with drag-and-drop between windows

• OpenStreetMap-based location picker

• AI response language selection including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Russian, Greek, Portuguese, Hindi, Chinese, and Arabic

• Available for Linux, Windows, macOS, and Flatpak

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
